name: sms-ring
description: Ring your phone at full volume with a secret SMS. Offline by design, open source.

scripts.build: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- vue-tsc --noEmit && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- vite build
scripts.cap:sync: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run assets:check && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run build && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run locales && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run assets:check && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run build && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run locales && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run assets:check && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run build && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run locales && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- cap sync ios
scripts.cap:sync:open:android: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run cap:sync:android && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- cap open android
scripts.cap:sync:open:ios: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run cap:sync:ios && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- cap open ios
scripts.release:version: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run native:versions
scripts.android:debug: node scripts/run-command.mjs -- npm run cap:sync:android && node scripts/android-release.mjs assembleDebug
